text: Eating a balanced diet is the foundation of a healthy lifestyle. This means filling your plate with fruits, vegetables, whole grains, and lean proteins, while limiting processed foods and sugary drinks. Regular exercise, even a brisk thirty-minute walk each day, strengthens your heart and boosts your energy. Equally important is getting enough sleep—around seven to eight hours—to allow your body to repair itself. However, true health also involves your mind. Managing stress through mindfulness or hobbies protects your mental health. Finally, achieving a healthy work-life balance is crucial. When you set aside time for rest, family, and fun, you prevent burnout and feel more fulfilled in every part of your life.
